title: Free frequency and powerset correspondence
statement: Let $J$ be a subset of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The free frequencies supported on $J$ are in bijection with the subsets of $J$: a free frequency is sent to its set of indices, and a subset is sent to the corresponding free frequency.
